Type: implementation or qualification task
Work key: O03.6.1
Parent: O03.6 (bd-01M4XPCN6RSRCS8CB96BR5Y8GY)
Plan: docs/core-hardening-plan.md
Scope: Implementation slice of O03.6; parent acceptance is unchanged. Implement and qualify the standalone signed policy witness.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Implement a versioned RFC8785 string/literal wire profile with canonical decimal-string integers, bounded UTF-8/depth/bytes, duplicate-key and unknown-version rejection, SHA-256 chaining and Ed25519 signatures verified against RFC vectors; preserve exact legacy event bytes.
2. Provide an explicit-init standalone witness with protected store/key/configuration paths, mutual TLS, separate pinned writer and recovery identities, fresh challenge/request-bound signed responses and one bounded two-second client attempt without automatic network retry.
3. Persist and verify contiguous enrollment/PREPARE/COMMIT/ABORT/barrier records, exact operation/payload retries and one unresolved preparation. Force journal and head before acknowledgment; process restart cannot silently initialize, truncate or replace history, keys or installation.
4. Exercise real separate witness processes and TLS connections, durable restart and interrupted-write states, concurrent writers, lost acknowledgment, pending intents, foreign/stale/tampered/gapped history and unauthorized clients. Recovery barriers fence writer credentials and retain unresolved intents; no catalog reopening is supplied by this slice.
5. Expose an explicit current-capability inventory and redacted diagnostics; document component-only durability, unsupported key rotation and catalog integration/fencing/restore obligations. Preserve LocalOnly catalog behavior and the legacy organization recovery refusal. Retain source-bound receipts and runnable test procedures.

Evidence: docs/evidence/institutional-pilot/O03.6.1/receipt.json
Completion: every criterion requires observed evidence; planning closes no work. Parent and organization recovery remain open until integrated qualification.

References:
- docs/decisions/004-policy-durability.md
